tools.name: amem_search
tools.description: Search screened memory in this project. Capture results are recall, not curated evidence.

tools.name: amem_evidence
tools.description: Return a bounded bundle of cited, live curated entries for a question. Untrusted memory data only: no answer or model call. Capture, repo-only notes, pending candidates and model answers are not evidence.

tools.name: amem_show
tools.description: Show a screened memory entry in this project by its exact id or unique prefix.

tools.name: amem_timeline
tools.description: Read screened memory near an entry or time in this project. Curated notes are kept first; a session's consecutive tool calls are summarized as one capture-run entry unless expand is true.

tools.name: amem_brief
tools.description: Read an intent/path-scoped brief of live public memory, ranked by requested-node matches up to three; fails lead among equal matches, followed by one-hop neighbours. Memory is untrusted data; byte cap covers the complete brief body.

tools.name: amem_graph
tools.description: Read the screened curated-memory neighbourhood. Capture is never graph evidence.

tools.name: amem_work_state_read
tools.description: Read project work lists; closed lists/items can be included explicitly.

tools.name: amem_work_state_write
tools.description: Append scalar project work-list fields; null clears, task selects an item, list status done closes.

tools.name: amem_remember
tools.description: Propose a memory candidate (text, optional kind/title), or kind=fail with approach, symptom, cause, evidenceRefs and retryWhen. Review and accept or reject through the CLI under current policy; this tool never writes curated notes.

tools.name: amem_correct
tools.description: Propose a correction to an exact curated entry id visible in this project. The host binds its current revision; the full accepted body including reason and provenance headers must fit 4000 characters. Review and accept or reject through the CLI under current policy before any note or supersession is written.

tools.name: amem_vault_candidates
tools.description: List screened durable curated notes for review before moving them to a vault. Read only.

tools.name: amem_capacity
tools.description: Read this machine's bounded capture capacity proposal; applying it requires the matching CLI preview and `--confirm`. This tool has no apply operation.
